$comment: Mdigital React Native library whitelist/blacklist (Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86, New Architecture). Same schema and spirit as frontend-pack/rules/libraries.json; the web data/forms/errors contracts apply unchanged. Install native packages with `npx expo install`. Anything not listed: ask the user before installing.

allowed.name: expo (SDK 57) + development builds
allowed.use_for: Runtime, native modules, config plugins, EAS Build/Update
allowed.reason: Recommended way to start React Native apps; SDK 57 ships RN 0.86 + React 19.2 with the New Architecture; dev builds allow any native module

allowed.name: typescript (strict)
allowed.use_for: All code
allowed.reason: Same strictness as web; Expo SDK 56+ supports TS 6

allowed.name: expo-router
allowed.use_for: File-based routes in src/app, stacks, tabs, modals, deep links, typed routes
allowed.reason: Expo's router; since SDK 56 it owns its navigation core, deep links and typed hrefs come for free

allowed.name: react-native-unistyles (v3) + react-native-nitro-modules
allowed.use_for: All styling: typed theme from Figma variables, light/dark adaptive themes, variants, breakpoints, insets
allowed.reason: StyleSheet-compatible API (easy to read and to fall back from), full TypeScript theme typing, theme switching without React re-renders via a C++ core, built for the New Architecture

allowed.name: react-native-safe-area-context
allowed.use_for: Safe-area insets and SafeAreaView
allowed.reason: Required by Expo Router; core RN SafeAreaView is deprecated

allowed.name: react-native-reanimated (v4) + react-native-worklets
allowed.use_for: All animations, skeleton pulse, layout transitions, useReducedMotion
allowed.reason: Runs on the UI thread; v4 targets the New Architecture

allowed.name: react-native-gesture-handler
allowed.use_for: Swipe, pan, long-press, swipeable rows
allowed.reason: Native gesture recognition; required by sheets and swipeables

allowed.name: expo-image
allowed.use_for: All images: remote, local, SVG files, blurhash/thumbhash placeholders
allowed.reason: Caching, placeholders, transitions and contentFit in one maintained Expo module

allowed.name: @shopify/flash-list (v2)
allowed.use_for: Every data list and grid
allowed.reason: v2 is rewritten for the New Architecture, no size estimates, recycling for smooth scroll

allowed.name: lucide-react-native + react-native-svg
allowed.use_for: Icons; custom SVG icon components
allowed.reason: Same icon set as web (lucide-react), color via prop

allowed.name: @expo/ui
allowed.use_for: Bottom sheets, date/time pickers, native menus
allowed.reason: Production-ready since SDK 56 with SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose backed components and drop-in replacements for community sheet/date picker libraries

allowed.name: sonner-native
allowed.use_for: Toasts
allowed.reason: Same API as web sonner; one Toaster in providers

allowed.name: expo-font, expo-splash-screen, expo-system-ui, expo-status-bar
allowed.use_for: Fonts from Figma, splash, root background, status bar style
allowed.reason: Config-plugin based, no native code edits

allowed.name: expo-haptics
allowed.use_for: Feedback on important actions (success, destructive confirm)
allowed.reason: Platform-correct haptics; optional, never the only feedback

allowed.name: react-native-keyboard-controller
allowed.use_for: KeyboardAwareScrollView, KeyboardStickyView, keyboard-driven animations
allowed.reason: Consistent iOS/Android keyboard handling; documented in Expo's keyboard guide

allowed.name: @tanstack/react-query (v5)
allowed.use_for: All server state, cache, mutations, infinite lists
allowed.reason: Same data layer as web; focusManager/onlineManager adapters for AppState and NetInfo

allowed.name: fetch (native) via src/shared/api/http.ts + zod
allowed.use_for: Every HTTP request, response validation, typed ApiError
allowed.reason: Same contract as frontend-pack react-error-handling; no dependency

allowed.name: @react-native-community/netinfo
allowed.use_for: Online state for onlineManager and offline UI
allowed.reason: Standard connectivity API

allowed.name: react-native-mmkv
allowed.use_for: fast key-value storage (settings, tokens via secure alternative where needed)
allowed.reason: Synchronous, fast, New Architecture native module. Query cache persistence only through the conditional persister below (offline-first screens)

allowed.name: expo-secure-store
allowed.use_for: Tokens and secrets
allowed.reason: Keychain / Keystore backed

allowed.name: react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers + zod (v4)
allowed.use_for: All forms via Controller around shared Input
allowed.reason: Same as web; uncontrolled performance, schema validation

allowed.name: react-i18next + i18next + expo-localization
allowed.use_for: All visible strings, plurals, device locale
allowed.reason: Same library and key format as web; expo-localization reads device locales and text direction

allowed.name: @sentry/react-native
allowed.use_for: Crash and error reporting, Sentry.wrap on root layout, source maps via EAS
allowed.reason: Official Expo integration with automatic source-map upload on EAS Build

allowed.name: react-error-boundary (v6)
allowed.use_for: Feature-level fallbacks inside a screen
allowed.reason: Same as web; route-level errors use Expo Router ErrorBoundary exports

allowed.name: eslint-config-expo + typescript-eslint strict + eslint-plugin-react-hooks
allowed.use_for: Linting with max-lines 150 on .tsx
allowed.reason: Expo's flat config plus the web rule set

allowed.name: jest-expo + @testing-library/react-native + msw
allowed.use_for: Unit and component tests, network mocks
allowed.reason: Expo's preset; tests assert roles and labels; msw works in React Native

conditional.name: nativewind (v4.2, Tailwind 3)
conditional.when: Existing project already on it, or a team that shares Tailwind class recipes with web and accepts v4 (v5 with Tailwind 4 is still pre-release)
conditional.reason: Largest adoption and fast prototyping, but weak TS theme typing and a Tailwind major behind our web stack

conditional.name: tamagui
conditional.when: A universal app where one component library must render on web and native with an optimizing compiler
conditional.reason: Full design system and token engine; heavy, its own component conventions

conditional.name: StyleSheet (react-native) + typed theme via context
conditional.when: Unistyles cannot be installed (old architecture, Expo Go-only prototype)
conditional.reason: Same tokens and file layout, theme from a ThemeProvider hook; migration to Unistyles is mechanical

conditional.name: @gorhom/bottom-sheet (v5)
conditional.when: Projects below SDK 56 or sheets needing custom snap-point behaviour @expo/ui lacks

conditional.name: react-native-reusables
conditional.when: Project already uses NativeWind and wants shadcn-like primitives
conditional.reason: shadcn port for RN; only together with NativeWind

conditional.name: @tanstack/query-sync-storage-persister + @tanstack/react-query-persist-client
conditional.when: Offline-first screens that must show cached data after a cold start
conditional.reason: Persist the query cache to MMKV with a buster and maxAge

conditional.name: axios
conditional.reason: Same rule as web: wrap in http.ts, still map to ApiError

conditional.name: zustand
conditional.when: Genuinely global client state (onboarding progress, draft across screens)
conditional.reason: Same rule as web; never for server data

conditional.name: expo-sqlite / drizzle-orm
conditional.when: Large offline datasets or relational local data
conditional.reason: Query cache is not a database

conditional.name: maestro
conditional.reason: Simple YAML flows on simulators and CI

conditional.name: @lingui/react
conditional.reason: Recommended by Expo docs; do not mix with i18next

forbidden.name: NativeBase
forbidden.reason: Deprecated by its authors

forbidden.name: React Native Paper, UI Kitten, react-native-elements, gluestack-ui as the design system
forbidden.instead: shared/ui primitives styled from Figma tokens
forbidden.reason: Ship their own design language and theming model that fights the Figma tokens

forbidden.name: styled-components / emotion for React Native
forbidden.reason: Runtime style generation, second theming system

forbidden.name: Inline style objects with literal colors or sizes
forbidden.reason: Breaks dark mode and token sync

forbidden.name: SafeAreaView from 'react-native', react-native-safe-area-view
forbidden.reason: Deprecated / iOS-only

forbidden.name: FlatList / ScrollView+map for data lists
forbidden.reason: Worse recycling and memory on long lists; FlatList acceptable only for <20 static items

forbidden.name: react-native-fast-image
forbidden.reason: Unmaintained

forbidden.name: @expo/vector-icons, react-native-vector-icons (legacy package), FontAwesome packs
forbidden.reason: @expo/vector-icons replaced in SDK 56; one icon set across web and mobile

forbidden.name: RN Animated API for new animations, react-native-animatable, lottie for UI micro-interactions
forbidden.reason: JS-thread animations jank; one animation library

forbidden.name: react-native-size-matters, react-native-responsive-screen and other px-scaling helpers
forbidden.reason: Scale everything by screen width, break font scaling and accessibility

forbidden.name: react-native-keyboard-aware-scroll-view, manual Keyboard listeners
forbidden.reason: Unmaintained / inconsistent across platforms

forbidden.name: allowFontScaling={false} on screens
forbidden.reason: Blocks Dynamic Type and Android font scale

forbidden.name: @react-navigation/* used directly next to Expo Router, react-native-navigation (Wix)
forbidden.reason: Two navigation systems; Expo Router no longer depends on React Navigation

forbidden.name: fetch in useEffect + useState, SWR, RTK Query, Apollo
forbidden.reason: Same as web

forbidden.name: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage for tokens
forbidden.reason: Unencrypted storage

forbidden.name: Redux, MobX, Recoil (new projects)
forbidden.instead: TanStack Query + local state + zustand if needed
forbidden.reason: Same as web

forbidden.name: formik, yup
forbidden.reason: Same as web

forbidden.name: Hard-coded strings, react-native-localize + custom dictionaries
forbidden.reason: One i18n system, same key format as web

forbidden.name: Dimensions.get('window') at module scope
forbidden.reason: Stale on rotation, split view and foldables

forbidden.name: console.log as logging, moment.js
forbidden.reason: Same as web; moment is in maintenance mode and heavy
